text:
acme-admin: Hey team, after the maintenance window our org (acme-corp) can't deploy models and the billing page shows 403. Everything worked earlier today. Can someone check?

katie_cs: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact error and org id? Also what time did you first see it?

acme-admin: Org: org_2847. First noticed at ~2026-03-19T21:16Z. CLI deploy returns:
```
Error 403: permission_denied: missing permission models.deploy
request_id=req_0a1b2c3d
```
Billing console just shows a blank page and 403 in the devtools.

samir: I'm on it. Pulling audit logs now. If you have a user id of someone affected that helps.

acme-admin: user: jane.doe@acme.com (exists in SSO). All members in Billing Admin and Model Deploy groups are blocked.

audit-bot: Audit snippet:
```
2026-03-19T21:15:02Z role.update actor=infra-bot change="billing_admin -> billing_view" org=org_2847 script=rbac-refactor-v3
2026-03-19T21:15:03Z role.update actor=infra-bot change="model_deployer -> model_readonly" org=org_2847 script=rbac-refactor-v3
2026-03-19T21:15:03Z role.update actor=infra-bot change="service:rbac-mapping" details="regex mismatch"
```

chris-sec: That looks like the automated RBAC refactor (rbac-refactor-v3) we ran in the evening. We've seen a regex edge case drop trailing underscores in role slugs, mapping some _admin roles to readonly variants. Opening a priority incident. cc @ashley-dev for rollback.

ashley-dev: Confirmed. I can roll back the migration for org_2847, but need approval to run rollback which will touch mapping exports. Recommend immediate rollback + targeted regrant of missing admin roles.

katie_cs: @acme-admin do you want us to proceed now with rollback? We can then reapply the corrected mapping.

acme-admin: Please proceed asap. It's blocking production.

ops-bot: Initiating rollback: /ops rollback rbac-refactor-v3 --scope org_2847 --author ashley-dev --start 2026-03-19T21:15:00Z

ashley-dev: Rolling back the mapping now. Will also re-run grants for billing_admin and model_deployer while we validate.

samir: Regranted via CLI:
```
redwood rbac grant --org org_2847 --role billing_admin --member group:acme-billing-admins
redwood rbac grant --org org_2847 --role model_deployer --member group:acme-model-deployers
```

ops-bot: Rollback complete (run id rb-20260319-01). Audit note: rollback applied to org_2847.

katie_cs: Can someone from Acme test deploy and billing console?

acme-admin: Confirming — deploy succeeded for jane.doe and billing page loads again. Thank you! :tada:

chris-sec: We'll push a fix to rbac-refactor-v3 to handle trailing underscores and add unit tests for role slug normalization. Also adding a preflight dry-run that fails hard if any mapping would reduce privileges.

samir: Follow-up tickets: SEC-4321 (fix mapping regex and tests), SRE-987 (preflight dry-run), CS-2106 (customer communication + postmortem).

katie_cs: Noted. I'll follow up with an incident summary and cc billing on credits for downtime. Thanks everyone.

acme-admin: Appreciated — please keep us posted on root cause and prevention steps.
thread_summary: Customer reported 403s for deployments and billing after RBAC refactor. Audit logs showed automated migration mapped admin roles to readonly variants due to regex bug. Team rolled back migration, re-granted admin roles, restored access. Follow-up tickets created for fix and preflight checks.
